title: Enterprise billing & packaging intake: triage rubric and playbook
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Objective: Create a repeatable intake and prioritization playbook for enterprise pricing/packaging and billing requests (commitments, invoicing templates, cost allocation, marketplace contracts). Scope covers non-bug customer asks from sales/CS/partners that require product decisions or engineering work; excludes regulatory/legal contract negotiation (handled by legal) and pure accounting adjustments (handled by finance).

Why this ticket: Over the past two quarters we saw 18 ad-hoc enterprise billing asks that took 3-8 weeks each to resolve. Lack of consistent intake, inconsistent signals to eng, and unclear routing to finance/partners has led to missed SLAs and opaque cost for customers. The playbook will reduce cycle time, standardize decisions, and surface trade-offs for costs vs. reliability.

Deliverables:
- Intake form template for Sales/CS/Partner (fields + examples).
- Prioritization rubric with scoring (customer ARR, strategic value, implementation effort, compliance risk).
- Routing matrix that maps request type to owners (PM, Billing Ops, Legal, ENG infra).
- Standard responses and SLAs for each triage bucket (Quick/Medium/Deep).
- Example PRD for a commitment + invoicing change and a marketplace listing workflow.
- Implementation checklist for eng: API changes, invoice schema, audit logs, testing.

Scope details: 
- Commitments: standard term sheets (commit size, usage floors, overage model), auto-renew options. Playbook should specify when to accept custom overage vs. require dedicated reserved capacity.
- Invoicing: templates, line-item conventions (model name, tokens, compute tier), required metadata for customer accounting (PO numbers, tax IDs).
- Cost allocation: tagging recommendations, billing center-of-cost fields, exportable CSVs for finance teams.
- Marketplace: minimal metadata and pricing tiers required for marketplace listing, approver list and lead time.

Triage rubric (candidate scoring): 
- Customer ARR & strategic: 0-5
- Likelihood to convert / close deal: 0-5
- Implementation effort (ENG + Billing Ops): 0-5 (lower is better)
- Security/compliance risk: 0-5 (higher risk downgrades priority)
- Reusability across customers: 0-3
- Time sensitivity: 0-3
Total possible: 21
Buckets: 
- 16-21 -> High: assign P0, target resolution 10 business days, cross-functional warroom if >$250k ARR
- 11-15 -> Medium: assign P1, target 3 sprints
- <=10 -> Low: backlog, provide templated response

Routing matrix (examples):
- Commitment terms requiring contract language -> PM + Sales lead + Legal (route to Legal queue)
- Invoicing line-item changes -> Billing Ops + Engineering (API/invoice pipeline)
- Cost allocation / tagging -> Billing Ops + Customer Success + ENG (export/metadata changes)
- Marketplace listing -> PM + Partnerships + Billing Ops

Acceptance criteria: 
- Intake form published to internal Sales/CS Confluence page and linked from partner playbook.
- Rubric doc with examples (3 sample scored requests) stored in product drive.
- Routing matrix agreed and owners assigned for each mapping.
- Two pilot requests processed via playbook (one commitment, one invoice template) and post-mortem documented.

Trade-offs and decisions: 
- Standardization vs. bespoke: we prioritize standard templates for speed; bespoke is allowed for strategic customers (> $250k ARR) but requires Legal + Finance sign-off.
- Autoscaling vs. reserved capacity for commitment discounts: recommend reserved for >X commit because of unit economics, but allow hybrid for pilot phases.
- Marketplace listing gating: require a minimum billing metadata schema to avoid deferred engineering debt.

Implementation notes for ENG (high level): 
- API changes: extend invoice schema with billing_metadata map (fields: model_name, compute_tier, commitment_id, cc_allocation_code).
- Backfill/migration: Billing Ops to provide mapping for historical invoices if needed.
- Analytics: add events for "commitment_applied", "invoice_line_generated", and expose to Console usage dashboards.

Metrics to track: 
- Cycle time from intake -> resolution (goal: median <= 10 business days for High).
- Number of bespoke billing requests per quarter (goal: reduce by 60% via templates).
- CS satisfaction score on billing changes.

Stakeholders: 
- Responsible: Marco Rossi (PM), Billing Ops (TBD), ENG infra (lead: Elena Novak), Legal (owner: Jordan Lee), Sales (owner: Maya Singh), Finance (owner: Samuel Green).
- Reviewers: VP Product, Head of Sales, Head of Finance.

Links / artifacts:

- Example invoice PRD: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/BILL/Invoice+Line+Items
- Pilot request notes (link to case docs): https://drive.redwood.ai/cs/cases/PRJ-9987

Next steps:

- 2026-03-06: Send rubric to Eng & Billing Ops for feedback (review completed).
- 2026-03-10: Run two pilot requests, collect post-mortem.
